searchText: For the CL light client protocol yes the general design to date has been to keep the SSZ/RLP encodings at each respective layer if we want to pull SSZ logic into the EL then we need to see if the EL devs are ok with that Fwiw this has already caused some confusion diagnosing a prysm bug against Nethermind cc <@912415191067676693> But I suppose that adopting SSZ on the EL is just as hard as adopting RLP on the CL. So probably better and more practical to document these issues
